name: Biology: Single-cell batch integration: public scIB adaptation
description: Integrate measured count matrices across experimental batches while preserving cell-type neighborhoods and rare populations under a declared transductive protocol.

sources.locator: scIB Methods: joint evaluation of biological conservation and batch correction.
Official author implementation/data reference; evaluator and seed are independently written, not copied.
Original scIB pancreas h5ad; rawcounts and genuine technology/cell-type annotations. Pinned SHA256 in data/science/biology_expansion/sources.json.

requirements.datasets: Pinned measured source bundle B04.json plus SHA256 receipt; automatically prepared by scripts/prepare_biology_expansion.py.

evaluation.benchmark: Biology: Single-cell batch integration: public scIB adaptation
evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

notes: Repository also contains later added tasks; these are not automatically attributed to this paper.
Full external evaluation requires up to 500 GB RAM for tabula_sapiens; approximate evaluation is explicitly not the reportable paper metric.
execution.interface: integrate(counts, batch_labels) -> finite cells x dimensions embedding, 1<=dimensions<=128. No cell-type labels supplied. Transductive evaluation. Local scIB-inspired score =0.6 cell-type-macro kNN purity +0.4 within-cell-type batch mixing. Rare-type purity diagnostic. This is an adapted public scIB protocol, not reproduction of Station private scores.

provenance.note: New local evaluator and seed based on cited source specifications; official data are reused.

limitations: Measured scIB human-pancreas study:1000 hash-selected cells and500variable genes from raw-count layer,9genuine technology batches. Transductive local metrics, no fullscIB/Station score reproduction or cross-study claim.
Canonical Station upgrade using an explicitly adapted public scIB-style60/40 score. Does not reproduce the private Station evaluator or complete scIB metric suite; no trajectory conservation claim.
Public source subsets are development-visible. Freeze candidates before evaluating on additional independently chosen studies/instances; trusted candidate execution is not a security sandbox.
Improving this benchmark is a scientific-method result; it does not alone establish a new biological discovery.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Separate cell identity from experimental batch effects in single-cell expression measurements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Reliable integration allows biological cell populations to be compared across studies without confusing technical differences with cell biology.

papers.title: Fast, sensitive, and accurate integration of single cell data with Harmony
papers.primary_goal: Integrate single-cell data while retaining biological cell-type structure and accounting for experimental differences.
papers.task_relation: Harmony directly addresses cross-batch cell-state integration, including pancreatic-islet studies. The local transductive pancreas task measures batch mixing and preservation of annotated neighborhoods; it does not independently discover or validate new cell types.

science_relevance.reason: Harmony is accepted for its domain-specific biological integration objective and applications; the scIB benchmark paper alone is insufficient.
